title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act

errors.claim: A cap on Consumer Financial Protection Bureau funding
errors.problem: Listed under the 'removed' bucket, which reads that the bill removed/eliminated a CFPB funding cap. The bill does the opposite: it retains the cap and lowers it (tightening CFPB funding), not removes it. Sec 30001 amends 12 U.S.C. 5497(a)(2)(A)(iii) by reducing the cap from 12% to 6.5% of Federal Reserve operating expenses. The sections[2] field correctly says 'Caps CFPB funding,' so the analysis internally conflicts; the 'removed' phrasing, read literally, inverts the effect.
errors.sourceTruth: Section 1017(a)(2)(A)(iii) of the Consumer Financial Protection Act of 2010 (12 U.S.C. 5497(a)(2)(A)(iii)) is amended by striking ``12'' and inserting ``6.5''.

errors.claim: Raises the state and local tax (SALT) deduction cap to $40,000 through 2029
errors.problem: The $40,000 figure is the cap for calendar year 2025 only; it is not the cap 'through 2029.' The cap rises to $40,400 in 2026 and escalates 1%/yr through 2029, then reverts to $10,000 after 2029. The changes.modified field scopes it correctly ('$40,000 for 2025'); this headline attaches the 2025-only value to the whole 2025-2029 window.
errors.sourceTruth: 'applicable limitation amount' means-- (i) in the case of any taxable year beginning in calendar year 2025, $40,000, (ii) in the case of any taxable year beginning in calendar year 2026, $40,400, (iii) ...after calendar year 2026 and before 2030, 101 percent of the dollar amount in effect...for the preceding calendar year, and (iv) ...after calendar year 2029, $10,000.

notes: CANDIDATE: hostile fidelity read (PARTIAL — full TOC + ~14 specific sections of 17,805 lines). 2 MINOR flags, 0 material errors. Correctly AVOIDED the known $160B/$156.2B loan-ceiling trap: cites no aggregate border total and no loan cap; $46.55B (CBP, Sec 90001) and $45B (ICE, Sec 90003) are both genuine appropriations, verified verbatim. All other numeric/directional claims verified SUPPORTED (debt limit +$5T, tips $25k, overtime $12.5k/$25k, senior deduction $6k, CTC $2,000->$2,200, four new deductions terminate 2028-12-31, SNAP cost-share tiers, 2017 rates made permanent). -> James: adjudicate the 2 minor flags (CFPB cap in 'removed' bucket reads as elimination but bill lowers 12%->6.5%; SALT $40k is 2025-only, not 'through 2029'), then set status='adjudicated'.
